channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Israeli Arab firefighter arrested for terror plot
item.description: Shin Bet and police say 19-year-old Kafr Qassem firefighter contacted Hamas and Iranian agents, sought to form a terror cell and identified a sensitive target.

item.title: Mamdani sues Trump: Wants immigrants
item.description: New York and 21 other states across the US are suing the Trump administration, claiming that a new rule that will make it more difficult for immigrants to enter the US will cause them financial losses.

item.title: What a graffiti says about journalism, the AfD, and the future of German Jewry
item.description: The same ugly graffiti that elites now parade as proof that the AfD is poised to act like Nazis actually demonstrates the opposite. Hundreds of vile graffiti targeting Jews appear daily in German and European cities and no one cares. Opiniion.

item.title: Zelensky: We will stop attacks on Russia if we receive guarantees
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky declares that his country is ready to stop attacks on Russia - if the negotiating partners - guarantee that the Russians will refrain from damaging energy facilities, infrastructure, and food supply routes.

item.title: Democrats ask Elections Committee to bar Otzma Yehudit from race
item.description: Yair Golan’s Democrats ask Elections Committee to disqualify Otzma Yehudit, citing racism; Ben-Gvir’s party responds by calling Democrats ‘anti-Israel.’

item.title: Strangling Iran: Will Trump’s endgame win out?
item.description: Will Washington tie its measures together so financial pressure becomes a noose that follows Iranian trade on the sea, in the air, through banks and possibly across land borders too? And makes the routes still left to Iran impossibly expensive?

item.title: Trump says he's 'open to the concept' of negotiations with Iran
item.description:
US President Donald Trump revealed on Monday that he is open to negotiations with Iran.
"The failing Nation of Iran wants to make a deal, quickly and badly. I will determine whether or not the U.S.A. will choose to engage - The concept of which we are open to," he wrote on Truth Social.

item.title: Macklemore removed from Ed Sheeran tour amid anti-Israel controversy
item.description: Macklemore is removed from eight Ed Sheeran tour dates after venues reportedly refused to host him following his ‘Free Palestine’ performances.

item.title: Netanyahu warns Hezbollah: Next attack will bring ‘heavier blows’
item.description: Netanyahu hails the destruction of Hezbollah strongholds in southern Lebanon and warns that any renewed attack on Israel will be met with even heavier blows.

item.title: Following Attorney General’s intervention: Memorial event for Rabbi Ovadia Yosef canceled
item.description: The major event planned in memory of Rabbi Ovadia Yosef has been canceled following the Attorney General’s directive regarding the election period.

item.title: Security forces arrest Fatah terrorist in Tulkarm who planned attacks, trafficked weapons
item.description:
In a joint operation, the IDF and Shin Bet launched an operation today (Monday) to thwart terrorist activity in the Tulkarm area.
Following an intelligence and operational manhunt conducted over the past several weeks, security forces arrested Muhammad Ibrahim Abd al-Wahab Shahada, who was a senior Fatah terrorist operative in Tulkarm.
The terrorist operative had been wanted in recent months for his alleged involvement in terrorist activity, including the planning and execution of attacks and the trafficking of weapons.

item.title: Nas Daily founder: Western activism has harmed the Palestinian cause
item.description: Nas Daily founder Nuseir Yassin accuses Paul Graham of empowering Palestinian extremists as the two clash over alleged terror links involving MSF staff.

item.title: Healthcare system prepares for winter: Hospitals instructed to prepare for rise in illness
item.description: The Health Ministry has instructed hospitals and health funds to prepare for an increase in respiratory illnesses and is urging the public to get vaccinated against the flu early.

item.title: Netanyahu seeks more defense funding; Lapid sets condition
item.description: Netanyahu asked to increase the defense budget. Lapid said he would support the move but demanded that it not be funded through tax increases. Likud responded with criticism.

item.title: Zamir orders legal review of ‘NAZA': ‘Based on blood libels’
item.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir orders legal review and special team to address ‘NAZA,’ accusing the film of blood libels that could endanger Israeli soldiers.

item.title: Captivity survivor rages at Naza producers: ‘The blood of our friends is on their hands’
item.description: Former hostage Eliya Cohen accuses Naza producers of spreading lies about Israel and IDF soldiers, calling for a lawful public protest against them.

item.title: Sometimes a perfect body has only one kidney
item.description: Israel is the country with the most altruistic kidney donors per capita.

item.title: IDF Spokesman slams film: “False allegations, distorted, disconnected from reality"
item.description: Brig. Gen. Effie Defrin rejects allegations presented in promo for “NAZA," invites filmmakers to show IDF the full film.

item.title: UCLA Chancellor condemns speech by 9/11 mastermind's laywer on 9/11
item.description: University where Judea Pearl teaches, whose son Danial was murdered by Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, hosts Mohammed's attorney on 25th anniversary of 9/11.

item.title: 17 pills per jar: Indictment reveals details of Prinok poisoning case
item.description: Jars of Prinok puree laced with the equivalent of at least 17 prescription pills each, prosecutors say.

item.title: Ramat Hasharon Torah group sounds the shofar for residents across the city
item.description: Members of Ramat Hasharon’s garin torani sounded the shofar at various locations across the city, reaching residents with the mitzvah of hearing the shofar, including several deeply moving encounters.

item.title: Iran: Israel is the ‘only winner’ of regional tensions
item.description: Tehran calls for dialogue with Gulf states as Saudi Arabia postpones planned Oman meeting, Iran International report says.

item.title: Newsmax: The fight over Israel is entering a new phase
item.description: What happens after the House votes to punish universities that boycott Israel? Newsmax examines the new bill, campus antisemitism, BDS activism, Hamas and Israel’s next moves.

item.title: IAEA: Almost no nuclear inspections in Iran for six months
item.description: IAEA chief Rafael Grossi warns inspectors have had virtually no access to Iran’s nuclear facilities for six months, raising 'serious proliferation' concerns.

item.title: Daycare horror: Assistant jailed for seven years for abusing 12 children
item.description: Daycare assistant Shelly Sheinker sentenced after security cameras capture dozens of incidents of abuse; prosecutors weigh appeal for harsher sentence.

item.title: Paralympic athlete suffers seizure during live TV interview
item.description: Puerto Rican Paralympic athlete Melanie Valdés Reyes suffered an epileptic seizure during a live morning TV interview, then shared the footage to raise awareness about the condition.

item.title: Lahav 433 officer wounded after gun accidentally fires
item.description: Senior police officer lightly injured by discharge from his personal handgun; incident under investigation.

item.title: Modzitz Rebbe hospitalized on Rosh Hashanah, returns to lead prayers
item.description: Modzitz Rebbe is rushed to hospital on Rosh Hashanah, but returns to lead holiday prayers.

item.title: ‘We want justice’: Family of murdered 7-year-old confronts accused killer in court
item.description: Hillel Mordechai Dadon’s family arrived at court as prosecutors filed charges against the man accused of murdering the seven-year-old in Beit Shemesh and attempting to kill his cousin.
